summary: Reads an element/track ID from this[199] (offset 0x31C) and switches on it: values 0x1A2..0x1AC each map to a power-of-two bitmask (1 through 1024) written to the output parameter, returning 1; any other value writes -1 to the output and returns 0. Dispatch uses a jump table at 0x00474DA4.

operations.description: Switch dispatch reads this[199] at offset 0x31C and compares it against case values 0x1A2 through 0x1AC.
Switch dispatch jumps through the table at 0x00474DA4 (jpt_474C95) to select the matching case handler.

For a recognized case, write the corresponding bitmask to the output parameter: 0x1A2->1, 0x1A3->2, 0x1A4->4, 0x1A5->8, 0x1A6->16, 0x1A7->32, 0x1A8->64, 0x1A9->128, 0x1AA->256, 0x1AB->512, 0x1AC->1024.
Return 1 after writing a recognized bitmask.
For an unrecognized ID (default case), write -1 to the output parameter.
Return 0 when the input ID is not in the recognized range.

unresolved: Owner object type is unknown; the meaning of the element ID at offset 0x31C and of the produced bitmask depends on the caller.
